milestones.label: Call for Contributions opens
milestones.note: Submission of contributions for talks, posters and workshops opens via the conference system.

milestones.label: Full paper / abstract submission deadline
milestones.note: Deadline for papers, abstracts and special formats is 23:59. Review is expected to take approximately 12 weeks.

milestones.label: Acceptance notification
milestones.note: All submitters receive notification about acceptance of their contribution.

milestones.label: Camera-ready submission deadline
milestones.note: Final submission deadline for accepted contributions.

milestones.label: GMDS 2027 conference
milestones.note: GMDS annual conference in Hannover, 5–9 September 2027.

slots.label: Full paper preparation
slots.note: Prepare the contribution for submission through the GMDS conference system.

slots.label: Review period
slots.note: The GMDS page states that review is expected to take approximately 12 weeks.

slots.label: Revision and camera-ready preparation
slots.note: Revise the accepted contribution and prepare the final camera-ready version.

slots.label: Conference preparation
slots.note: Prepare for presentation and participation after camera-ready submission.

processes.label: Preparing GMDS full paper
processes.note: The official GMDS 2027 page describes the 31 March 2027 deadline as covering papers, abstracts and special formats.
